question: On held-out images rendered by the official Newson Boolean simulator dataset, does an exact same-periodogram Gaussian surrogate reproduce higher-order residual structure at unresolved radii but fail at visible radii?

primary_source.citation: Lesne, Gousseau, Ladjal and Newson, Neural Film Grain Rendering, Computer Graphics Forum 44(2), 2025

bounded_source_selection.selection_rule: For each radius in ascending frozen order, sort eligible rows by SHA-256 of 'u6.p4ch-v1|test|index|img_name|seed|radius'; require the clean and grain members to exist; require globally unique img_name; take the first 16.
bounded_source_selection.member_integrity: central/local member identity, compression method, compressed and uncompressed size, CRC32, decoded PNG mode/shape and SHA-256
bounded_source_selection.decode_contract: single-frame grayscale uint8 PNG; exact clean/grain shape; drop first row and column exactly as the official loader; crop bottom/right to a multiple of 16 only for feature extraction

comparison.residual: float64(grain_uint8-clean_uint8)/255 after the official first-row/first-column crop
comparison.normalization: per-row residual mean subtraction and population-RMS division
comparison.gaussian_control: four deterministic real-valued random-phase surrogates per row, each preserving the exact residual periodogram and zero DC
comparison.distance_ratio: For each row and feature family, target-to-median-Gaussian feature RMSE divided by the median pairwise Gaussian-to-Gaussian feature RMSE; zero stochastic spread with nonzero target distance is infinite and is reported factually.
comparison.radius_summary: median row ratio per family and median across the three families

branch_rule.pass: Retain a research-only radius boundary on the official synthetic Newson reference and open a separate runtime LOD experiment; do not use the academic neural renderer or claim real-film calibration.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact official-dataset Gaussian LOD boundary without changing rows, radii, features, seeds or gates; retain the simpler P4BS Gaussian mechanism and require a materially different real or independently calibrated observable.

forbidden: replace missing archive members or infer their pixels
retune selection, radii, features, seeds or thresholds after target reads
copy or execute the academic-only neural implementation or pretrained weights
train a network or allow ML to generate final RGB
claim real-film, stock, process, scanner, product or visual-safety evidence
claim_ceiling: Bounded noncommercial synthetic-reference evidence about higher-order sufficiency of exact-spectrum Gaussian surrogates across official Newson simulator radii; not measured film, calibration, visual safety or product admission.
